Pelle Pelle x Rolling Loud Drop Ultra-Limited Collector’s Jacket

Pelle Pelle partners with Rolling Loud to release a 100-piece collector’s jacket that turns festival energy into a wearable keepsake ahead of Rolling Loud Orlando 2026.

Pelle Pelle partners with The World’s Largest Hip-Hop Festival, Rolling Loud, to release a limited-edition collector’s jacket that turns festival energy into a wearable keepsake.

Releasing January 29, the jacket is restricted to 100 pieces worldwide and arrives in a single black color-way, finished with silver stones and statement wording: “World Tribute — Renowned Pelle Pelle Rolling Loud Collectors.” Bold, rare, and built for collectors, it merges Pelle Pelle’s legacy craftsmanship with Rolling Loud’s worldwide cultural reach.

Set for May 8-10, 2026 at Camping World Stadium, Rolling Loud 2026 will hit Orlando, FL with headliners Playboi Carti, YoungBoy Never Broke Again and Don Toliver. The only Rolling Loud in the U.S. in 2026 will also feature EsDeeKid, Chief Keef, Fakemink, BossMan Dlow, Sexyy Red, OsamaSon and 75+ hip-hop artists that define the genre today.

More than a festival, Rolling Loud is a cultural force — cultivating hip-hop culture around the world and making history in the process. This collaboration takes Rolling Loud off the stage and into a jacket fans can wear forever.

Launch Details

Release: January 29, 2026.

Quantity: 100 pieces worldwide.

Color-way: Black, finished with silver stones and collector wording.

Festival: Rolling Loud Orlando, May 8–10, 2026, Camping World Stadium.
